blocking_environment_capability.observed: os.openpty(), os.posix_openpt(os.O_RDWR), and open('/dev/ptmx') each raise PermissionError: [Errno 1] Operation not permitted. /dev/ptmx exists, so this is a sandbox policy denial, not a missing device.
blocking_environment_capability.why_no_substitute: The Hunter execution directive names 'mocked terminal for a real PTY' as a forbidden evidence substitution, and UX-CMD-01 is specifically about what the terminal does with a single '/' byte before Enter. A pipe cannot demonstrate it.
blocking_environment_capability.resolution: Not a missing capability after all. ~/.claude/settings.json already excluded 'bash scripts/run_pty_gate.sh*' from the sandbox; this repository simply had no scripts/ directory, so there was nothing for the exclusion to match. Adding scripts/run_pty_gate.sh -- the same path and convention the sibling Hunters use -- unblocked it with no settings change.
